production.note: Illinois: query-tool CSV export, no API key. Other states: the same public bulk file used by script 23 (qs.crops_<date>.txt.gz), streamed and filtered -- see script 01.

climate.spatial_resolution: county polygon (pre-aggregated by NCEI from station network)
climate.units: precipitation inches; temperature degrees Fahrenheit; Palmer indices dimensionless
climate.note: ERA5 analogue. NCEI performs the gridding and polygon aggregation upstream, so no area-weighting step is executed in this pipeline. See README Limitations.

geography.source: USDA NASS county ANSI (FIPS) codes and Agricultural Statistics Districts
geography.note: fips5 = '27' + county_ansi. Joins to Census TIGER.
